_about: Make-row category 'Industrial' (Core/Tool/Shelf.cs; one file per category). Industrial (2026-10-19, the user: 'a whole new Industrial category ... industrial awesomeness ... like someone handcrafted it'): the handcrafted yards first (container yard, car yard, junk yard, industrial works: Core/Layers/Types/Industrial), then every type of the 'industrial' group that was hidden before (logistics yard, scrapyard, landfill, quarry, construction site, abandoned lot).
